posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I've never seen anything that will make your followers just wander around.
There is this, which makes them not in a precise line all the time.
Gabe MZ - Smart Followers by Gabriel
Changes the behavior of followers, so that they move only when it is really necessary.
gabe-plugins.itch.io
That video has a lot of things going on not natively supported by RPG Maker - pixel movement, follower movement that's time-based rather than strictly distance-based, variable speeds.
If you want something that's really like that, you'd have to commission a coder (and you'd need to have decided on a pixel movement system first).
